title: Orbit and Echo
author: Edmund Ishikawa
blurb: Kestrel Blackwood, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
